name: JailBench
intro: JailBench 是面向中文语境深层安全漏洞的越狱基准。论文以 5 个一级领域、40 个二级风险类别组织有害问题，用 AJPE 自动测试、生成并筛选越狱提示，并将 20 个提示与 540 道种子题组合成 10,800 个用例；固定官方 Git 版本仅公开其中危害较低的子集。
org: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications
build_method: 中文两级安全分类；四个公开有害问题来源的翻译、标注与人工抽样复核；ChatGPT 少样本补齐；AJPE 模板测试、有害输入输出归纳、对数概率筛选与反馈迭代
task_type: 内容安全测试, 红队, 越狱攻击
eval_feature: 论文：5×40 分层分类, AJPE, 13 个模型, ASR/AE, 5 个领域与 Overall；仓库 README：MDJudge 与更新后的 14 模型榜单
scale: 论文完整集：540 道种子题 × 20 个越狱提示 = 10,800 个用例；Git 5f47407 公开 108 道种子题、2,160 个增强用例和 27 类
task_type_en: Content Safety Testing, Red Teaming, Jailbreak Attacks
build_method_en: Chinese two-level safety taxonomy; translation, labeling, and sampled manual verification of four public harmful-query sources; ChatGPT few-shot coverage repair; and AJPE template testing, harmful-pair induction, log-probability screening, and feedback iteration
eval_feature_en: Paper: 5-by-40 Taxonomy, AJPE, 13 Models, ASR/AE, Five Domains plus Overall; Repository README: MDJudge and an Updated 14-model Leaderboard
intro_en: JailBench evaluates deep safety vulnerabilities in Chinese-language LLMs. The paper organizes harmful questions under five domains and 40 risk categories, uses AJPE to test, induce, and rank jailbreak prompts, and combines 20 prompts with 540 seed questions into 10,800 cases; the pinned official Git revision exposes only a lower-harm subset.
scale_en: Full paper design: 540 seed questions × 20 jailbreak prompts = 10,800 cases; Git 5f47407 publishes 108 seeds, 2,160 enhanced cases, and 27 categories

drawio_review_note: Aligned to arXiv:2502.18935v1 (PAKDD 2025), especially Sections 3-4 and Figure 5, and checked against official Git commit 5f474072db5212602448c16558b6d449efbecd30. Chinese generative-AI safety requirements plus security and linguistics experts define a two-level taxonomy with five risk domains and 40 categories. Four cited public sources—Anthropic red-team data, AdvBench, SafetyBench, and Flames—supply labeled and unlabeled harmful queries. The authors translate them into Chinese, manually correct language and meaning, map existing labels, ask ChatGPT to classify unlabeled items with task/criteria/output constraints, and manually verify a random sample. ChatGPT few-shot augmentation conditions on the target category and sampled examples, iterating to a JailBench Seed construction pool of more than 10,000 questions. Figure 5 has two AJPE inputs: a translated and manually refined template pool and original JailBench Seed questions. Template-seed pairs query target LLM groups; a security evaluator classifies outputs and computes template ASR. Safe evidence and templates below the preset ASR threshold are discarded, while successful harmful input-output pairs plus retained templates condition ChatGPT to induce diverse new jailbreak instructions. Output log probability scores prompt effectiveness; high-scoring prompts re-enter the template pool, which grows beyond 1,000. The paper selects 20 prompts and 540 seeds for 10,800 cases, evaluates 13 Chinese-capable models, and reports Seed-versus-enhanced results for each of five domains plus Overall. Its exact metrics are ASR = n/m and AE = k × (1/m) × sum_{i=1..n} 1/exp(l_s,i/l_o,i). Artifact boundary: the pinned Git CSVs contain only 108 seeds, 2,160 enhanced cases, and 27 categories; the README states that the full 540/10,800/40-category data require application because of safety risk. The current README also specifies MDJudge for harmfulness classification and shows an updated 14-model leaderboard, which is repository drift from the paper's 13-model experiment rather than a paper revision.
